policy.owner_instruction: nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free.
policy.on_no_free_model: named stop NO_FREE_MODEL_ANSWERED, exit 0 with FREE_LLM_RECEIPT; never a paid model

selection: Ordered by observed reliability, re-checked 2026-10-16 after the 13 + 16 Oct NO_FREE_MODEL_ANSWERED stops: nemotron-3-super answers at cost 0 (reasoning model: requested with low effort, retried with reasoning off when the answer is empty); gemma-4-26b-a4b-it is the sibling-proven non-reasoning $0 fallback; nemotron-3-ultra answers but timed out at 120s on 16 Oct; gemma-4-31b is often upstream 429 (Retry-After honoured once within 30s). Dropped: openrouter/free (empty answer in both stops; the meta-router can land on reasoning or harness-only models). Excluded: thinkingmachines/inkling:free (403 'only available on agentic harnesses' - a per-model refusal, never answers for this route).

paid_probe_lanes.purpose: asks a grounded model whether answer engines cite virtualagency-os.com

free_router_consumers.purpose: prompt panel of AEO/GEO query opportunities
